gen-zen-dots-gf-tenor-sans: Techy letters with lots of breathing space, friendly rather than cold. Zen Dots keeps that generosity at every weight, while Tenor Sans, plain sans in spirit, brings a light, visible thinning where the strokes turn.
gen-zen-dots-gf-varta: Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of room to breathe, with openings that stay generous at any weight. Varta is plain sans, with big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-zen-dots-gf-wix-madefor-display: Friendly and techy, Zen Dots leaves generous space around each letter. Wix Madefor Display, the sans-serif below, has gently flared curve ends that stay apart, so the two feel related yet clearly different.
gen-zen-dots-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text, a sans with open terminals that read at a glance, sets a quiet tone. Wix Madefor Text carries the reading, while Zen Dots, generous around every letter, grabs the eye.
gen-zen-dots-gf-ysabeau-office: Techy and friendly, Zen Dots leaves generous room around every letter shape at any weight. And Ysabeau Office, a sans with an open-ended look on every curved letter, gives the text a modern feel.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zalando-sans: Approachable from the first glance, Zen Dots gives every letter shape generous room. Zalando Sans keeps to plain sans manners, its open-ended curves making paragraphs of text feel easy going.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Zen Dots spreads generous room around every letter, giving a techy, friendly face. Zalando Sans Expanded keeps wide gaps between letters and c tips that never creep toward touching, so extended text reads cleanly.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpande: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded is a modern sans-serif with open-mouthed curves. Beneath Zen Dots and its generous letter spacing, a full paragraph should glide along without snagging on c, e, or s.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Generous room around every letter is what defines Zen Dots. ZCOOL XiaoWei brings a calm variation in weight from stem to serif, a quieter partner for that open display look.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Zen Dots surrounds every letter with plenty of room, and its openings stay generous at every weight. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique keeps rope-like consistency in every stem and tail.
